## What's free

5 Basic users; 1 Microsoft-hosted parallel job with 1,800 minutes/month; 1 self-hosted parallel job with unlimited minutes

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/devops/> before relying on this.

## Notes

New organisations may have to request the free Microsoft-hosted parallel job grant before pipelines run. Free minutes reset on the first day of each month.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
